title: Double response-size check (Content-Length + actual bytes) — defense-in-depth
description: All four response-reading paths (fetch_session, call, upload_blob, download_blob) check the Content-Length header AND the actual bytes.len() after reading. A server that lies in Content-Length would pass the header check but be caught by the actual-bytes check. A future contributor might remove one check as 'redundant'. Neither is. The header check is an early exit (avoid reading a large body before rejecting it); the actual-bytes check is the security guarantee. Both must stay.
